summary: Setting up a rulebook activation: Automation Decisions > Rulebook Activations > Create, then name, project, rulebook, credentials (Vault, AAP or custom types), decision environment (always pulled) and restart policy (Always and On failure restart up to 5 times; On failure waits 60 seconds).
questions: How do I create a rulebook activation?
What restart policies do rulebook activations have?
Can I change the decision environment pull policy?

answer_card.title: Rulebook activation restart policy
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Always**: restarts immediately whether it ended successfully or not, at most 5 times.
- **Never**: never restarts when the container process ends.
- **On failure**: restarts after 60 seconds (default), only when the process fails, at most 5 times.

The decision environment image is always pulled on each start; the pull policy can't be changed.
